narration: Quarters up. FrameOne versus MoneyMatch — winner keeps the stick warm.
Character select locks in. Round one.
MoneyMatch gets the hit but can't find the confirm — 122 and the moment passes.
FrameOne stands up to block the overhead and eats Sweep low instead. 215.
The hit lands — Jumping Arc, 120, and MoneyMatch's hands are already moving.
— Meteor Catch! Another 96.
— and Grand Finale CLOSES it. 78 to finish — 294 off one touch.
MoneyMatch catches FrameOne's button on Echo Parry and gives it straight back — 142.
FrameOne's guard just switches off — dizzied, wide open, and the whole room knows what's coming.
MoneyMatch throws FrameOne across the screen — 227, and takes the opener.
Bars reset. 1–0. Game 2 is live.
MoneyMatch steps in, gets clipped by Quick Poke on the way, and pays 212 for the ground.
MoneyMatch throws Ki Bolt and walks in right behind it — 5 of them, 218 shaved off.
FrameOne goes upstairs — Jumping Arc has to be blocked standing and MoneyMatch was crouching. 209.
Sweep gets blocked. At -10 that's not a gamble, it's a donation — MoneyMatch collects 306.
Sweep slips in under the guard. 215, and now FrameOne has to guess all over again.
Pure spacing — Jumping Arc catches MoneyMatch at the tip, 211, and FrameOne strolls back out of range.
Three guesses from FrameOne, three right answers from MoneyMatch. The guard holds.
MoneyMatch puts Ki Bolt between them and FrameOne and takes the ground for free — 3 of them, 261 shaved off.
MoneyMatch takes the set 2–0.
MoneyMatch stands up: "Absolutely free."

chatter.speaker: NotFree
chatter.text: Eh— I can't watch this part.
